title: GL-11 — API Gateway and Lambda
stopChargesPanel: Delete API, routes, Lambda, and log group.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on API Gateway and Lambda; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Lambda role and function
bullets: Run `aws iam create-role --role-name workbook-gl11-lambda --assume-role-policy-document file://gl11-trust.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-11 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`
Run `aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name workbook-gl11-lambda --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole`.
Run `$LambdaRoleArn = aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl11-lambda --query Role.Arn --output text`.

Run `$FunctionArn = aws lambda create-function --function-name workbook-gl11 --runtime python3.12 --role $LambdaRoleArn --handler lambda_function.lambda_handler --zip-file fileb://function.zip --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-11 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt --query FunctionArn --output text`.
Success: function Arn is set.

steps.title: HTTP API
bullets: Run `$ApiId = aws apigatewayv2 create-api --name workbook-gl11 --protocol-type HTTP --tags LabId=gl-11,Workbook=aws-tf-lab --query ApiId --output text`.

Run `$IntegrationId = aws apigatewayv2 create-integration --api-id $ApiId --integration-type AWS_PROXY --integration-uri $FunctionArn --payload-format-version 2.0 --query IntegrationId --output text`.
Run `aws apigatewayv2 create-route --api-id $ApiId --route-key 'GET /hello' --target integrations/$IntegrationId`.
Success: route exists.

steps.title: Deploy stage
bullets: Run `aws apigatewayv2 create-stage --api-id $ApiId --stage-name prod --auto-deploy`.

Run `aws lambda add-permission --function-name workbook-gl11 --statement-id apigw --action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal apigateway.amazonaws.com --source-arn "arn:aws:execute-api:us-east-1:$($AccountId):$($ApiId)/*/*"`. The `$( )` stops PowerShell from reading `$AccountId:` as a drive-qualified variable.
Success: stage is deployed.

steps.title: Invoke route
bullets: Run `$InvokeUrl = aws apigatewayv2 get-apis --query "Items[?ApiId=='$ApiId'].ApiEndpoint" --output text`.
Run `curl.exe "$InvokeUrl/prod/hello"`. In Windows PowerShell 5.1, plain `curl` is an alias for Invoke-WebRequest, so type `curl.exe`.
Success: HTTP 200 from Lambda.

steps.title: List routes
bullets: Run `aws apigatewayv2 get-routes --api-id $ApiId`.
Success: GET /hello is listed.

steps.title: Document cleanup order
bullets: Delete API, Lambda permission, function, log group, IAM role.
Success: order matches Stop charges.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: HTTP API, Lambda, IAM role
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-11` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-11 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-11 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-11. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: One HTTP API route integrated with Lambda; one successful test call.
